name: localgigfinder
description: Full-stack LocalGigFinder application with React frontend and Node/Express backend.

scripts.start:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production SERVE_FRONTEND=true npm start --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
